DitherFx.cell: Size of one dither cell in the effects.
DitherFx.color: The colour of the dots. Defaults to DitherTheme.ink.
DitherFx.strength: How bright the effects are, 0 to 1. It is multiplied by intensity.
DitherFx.hover: The effect that plays when the pointer enters, or follows it. Defaults to DitherMotion.hover.
DitherFx.press: The effect that plays when the pointer goes down. Defaults to DitherMotion.press.
DitherFx.idle: The effect that plays while nothing is happening. Defaults to DitherMotion.idle.
DitherFx.matrix: The dither pattern of the effects. Defaults to DitherMotion.matrix.
DitherFx.speed: How fast the effects play, 1 is normal. Defaults to DitherMotion.speed.
DitherFx.intensity: Scales how bright the effects are, 0 to 1. Defaults to DitherMotion.intensity.
DitherFx.pointer-enter: Tell it the pointer came in, at this position in the box. Starts the hover effect.
DitherFx.pointer-move: Tell it the pointer moved. Effects that follow the pointer, such as spotlight, use the position.
DitherFx.pointer-leave: Tell it the pointer left. Held effects, such as spotlight and rise, fade out.
DitherFx.pointer-focus: Tell it the box got keyboard focus. Starts the hover effects that play once, so keyboard users see them too. spotlight and rise follow the pointer and do not play on focus.
DitherFx.pointer-down: Tell it the pointer went down, at this position in the box. Starts the press effect.
